artists.biography: Dave Gahan (born 9 May 1962) is an English singer-songwriter, best known as the baritone lead singer for the British electronic music band Depeche Mode since their debut in 1980. He is also an accomplished solo artist, releasing albums in 2003 (Paper Monsters) and 2007 (Hourglass). Despite his bandmate Martin Gore continuing to be the main Depeche Mode songwriter, Gahan has contributed a number of songs to the band's most recent albums, Playing the Angel (2005) and Sounds of the Universe (2009). Two of these songs were released as singles, including "Suffer Well" in 2006 and "Hole to Feed" in 2009. Q magazine ranked Gahan no. 73 on the list of the "100 Greatest Singers" and no. 27 on "The 100 Greatest Frontmen".

perplexity.description:
Angels & Ghosts," released on October 23, 2015, is a collaborative album by Dave Gahan and the production duo Soulsavers, issued through Columbia Records. The album blends elements of rock with a strong influence of blues and soul, creating a cinematic and atmospheric sound that continues the moody, textured style Soulsavers are known for. It features a mix of gritty guitar work, soulful vocals by Gahan, and a dark, brooding production aesthetic that complements his distinctive voice.

This album follows Gahan's previous solo and collaborative works, marking a significant partnership with Soulsavers after their earlier joint album, The Light the Dead See (2012). "Angels & Ghosts" is notable for its raw emotional depth and a more stripped-down approach compared to Gahan's work with Depeche Mode, emphasizing a rock and blues-inflected sound rather than electronic music. Critically, the album was well-received for its haunting atmosphere and Gahan's compelling vocal performance, with reviewers highlighting its riveting and cinematic qualities. Commercially, it supported a tour featuring a 10-piece band, underscoring its live, organic feel.
